nodes.label: <script src="/theme-init.js"> in index.html <head>
nodes.rationale: Palette and skin are applied before first paint via an external file rather than an inline block, specifically so the CSP in vercel.json can refuse script-src 'unsafe-inline' outright.

nodes.label: iOS standalone / viewport-fit=cover hints
nodes.rationale: viewport-fit=cover plus safe-area padding makes the standalone iOS window look native instead of letterboxed; apple-mobile-web-app-* meta tags are iOS standalone hints since Safari still ignores parts of the manifest.
